integrity: Self-review only. No independent audit or expert certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Only finite, unweighted two-leg adjacency ladders with one positive corner sink; the graph-Laplacian variant, weighted couplings and other trap sets are outside scope. The finite checker supports but does not replace the cyclotomic proof. Historical priority may be subject to broader published graph controllability results.
title: An arithmetic on-off law for corner absorption on quantum ladders
